blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Defense counsel Kristine Ferrer says Vice President Sara Duterte had consented to the public viewing of a letter of authority (LOA) issued by the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) to Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio, despite the document’s confidential contents./ dp READ: Defense flashes confidential BIR tax audit letters for Duterte,
